item.title: Guía de Combos Básicos de Bayonetta
item.description:
Iniciando el Combo de la Bruja

Bayonetta en Ultimate destaca por su juego de combo vertical y su capacidad de llevar al rival al límite superior de la pantalla mediante sus movimientos especiales.

Movimientos Clave para Combos

  • Heel Slide (Lateral B en el suelo): Excelente iniciador a porcentajes bajos y medios.
  • After Burner Kick (Aéreo Lateral B): El motor de sus combos aéreos. Recuerda que si impactas al rival, puedes usarlo una segunda vez.
  • Witch Twist (Arriba B): Eleva al oponente y te permite seguir la secuencia en el aire.

item.title: Banjo & Kazooie
item.description:
Overview

Banjo’s a winning matchup for Bayo. Main reasons for this are his bad physics for escaping combos, meaning he takes a lot of damage and can die from some combos if his sdi isn’t the best. Plus his damage output is very low, specially compared to Bayo’s.

item.title: Falco
item.description:
Overview

Falco is a winning matchup for Bayonetta. What makes it good is Falco’s linear and reactable approaches, sub-par disadvantage and losing almost every air-to-air against abk. That being said, he can dish out a lot of damage with his combos and can kill Bayo easily if not careful; playing at a slow, comfortable pace and punishing his bad habits accordingly are key to beat him.

Neutral

Since both Bayo and Falco have a similar gameplan (slow characters, with a highly focused bait and punish gameplan) you can’t just run into him, as he’ll punish you hard with his uptilts and fairs. Instead, play second, let him approach most of the time and only go in when the time is right.

item.title: Game&Watch
item.description:
Overview

Game&Watch is an even matchup for Bayo. Reasons are mostly because he’s broken as a character, insane neutral, advantage and disadvantage. What makes it even for Bayo are her explosiveness with her combos, witch time and good disadvantage, which makes the matchup winnable. Still, GaW can be very hard to kill at times and have an unbreakable defense while being very punishing with his combos and ledgetrap, so patience and spacing are key in succeeding against him.

item.title: Ness
item.description:
Overview

Ness goes even versus Bayonetta. He’s small and hard-hitting, with decent ledgetrap, incredible neutral, has a very potent backthrow that kills around 110-120% from center-stage and can put up good damage with the right combos. Bayo’s biggest strength in this matchups is her overall better damage output per opening and advantage, since ness struggles to land, recover and get off the ledge.
